title: Infinitesimal Deformations of Generalized Parabolic Hitchin Pairs
summary: We develop the infinitesimal deformation theory of generalized parabolic Hitchin pairs (GPHs) on irreducible nodal curves. For any GPH $(E,φ,F(E))$ we associate an explicit three-term deformation complex $\mathcal{C}_{(E_\bullet,φ)}$ whose first hypercohomology $\mathbb{H}^1(\mathcal{C}_{(E_\bullet,φ)})$ parameterizes first-order deformations. As the main application, we prove that the coarse moduli space $\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{GPH}}$ of $1$-stable generalized parabolic Hitchin pairs of rank $n$ and degree $d$ with $\gcd(n,d)=1$ is a local complete intersection, smooth in codimension one, and…
